apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed
- "Lidarr doesn't know this artist" for artists Lidarr knows from Deezer (or Discogs): since 0.5.3 Tuna looked them up by name, which Lidarr's search doesn't always answer. Now as their source asks ("deezer:…"), then by name, and failing both, added by their id for Lidarr to fill in.
- Titles with "(con …)", "(featuring …)" or "(w/ …)" (since 0.5.4, words in brackets count): those are other artists, not part of the title.
- Copies were passed over for a word inside another ("Oliver" has "live" in it): the words that mark another version count only whole. More of them: extended, club mix, dub mix, acoustic, unplugged, VIP, rework, bootleg, mashup, nightcore.
- Artists written without spaces in a copy's path ("SeeMaw" for See Maw) count.
- Handing songs to Lidarr runs once at a time (Look again pressed twice started two, and MusicBrainz said it was busy); what couldn't be checked is tried again within the hour, and the log says in one line how many were and how many are still on no album Lidarr has.

To update: the server (pull the new image). The apps need nothing new.
